newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Fed cattle and boxed beef prices lower but distant months may see support.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.150 to up 0.100 cent. Market technically weak but index up and corn futures seen lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Higher live calls and pork cutout values up but rolling may weigh on June.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Cash firmer and kills remain light but opinions mixed on out-of-town report.
